name: providing-performance-optimization-advice
description: This skill enables Claude to provide comprehensive, prioritized performance optimization recommendations for software projects. It is triggered when the user requests performance improvements, optimization suggestions, or asks for a performance review. The skill analyzes frontend, backend, and infrastructure aspects of the project to identify bottlenecks and anti-patterns. It then provides actionable advice, estimates potential performance gains, and suggests a phased implementation roadmap. Use this skill when the user mentions "optimize performance", "performance recommendations", "performance review", "improve speed", or asks about "bottlenecks".
